name: fix-item-actions-eat
about: hwplib bag item actions (moved from droptrade, issue #13): each action has its own hint and key in Order; the fish's Eat is [F] after [Q] Drop, never E (the menu's Destroy key, MenuAdditional), F eats it with no destroy dialog, and a bag item in town has no Send home hint. The self-check logs every action's key and no clash with a menu key. Rebinding Eat to C or E is flagged (hwp itemkeys): every binding of the current map counts, not only an action's first.

steps.pattern: item action eat key C \(6\) CLASHES with the menu's PlayerMenu key
steps.name: a menu action's second key clashes (PlayerMenu is I and C)

steps.pattern: item action eat key E \(8\) CLASHES with the menu's MenuAdditional key

steps.name: hwplib bag item actions (moved from droptrade, issue #13): e
